# FontWeight

`Flare.Components.FontWeight`

Font weight override for FlareText. Default keeps the weight defined by the active type scale; the other values map to the standard CSS numeric weights via shared flare-text--weight-* classes (no inline style needed).

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Default` | `0` | Use the type scale's own weight (no override). |
| `Thin` | `1` | Thin - 100. |
| `ExtraLight` | `2` | Extra Light - 200. |
| `Light` | `3` | Light - 300. |
| `Regular` | `4` | Regular - 400. |
| `Medium` | `5` | Medium - 500. |
| `SemiBold` | `6` | Semi Bold - 600. |
| `Bold` | `7` | Bold - 700. |
| `ExtraBold` | `8` | Extra Bold - 800. |
| `Black` | `9` | Black - 900. |

## Used by components

- `FlareText`
